title: Blue Book: Kecksburg material sent to Project Greengrass (Mount Weather)
place_text: Kecksburg, Pennsylvania; Michigan; Mount Weather, Virginia

tellings.quote: another one that said it was sent to project code word greeng grass and I wonder what that is. I look it up. It's Mount Weather.

plain: Something recovered at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, where an object is said to have come down in 1965, was reportedly sent to a project with the code word "Greengrass," according to a record from Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. The researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels he found that record among the Blue Book files, looked the code word up, and found it meant Mount Weather, a government site in Virginia. If he is right, the Kecksburg material went to a high-security government facility and not, as one might expect, to an ordinary Air Force lab.
